Standard_College_Name: AAA College of Engineering and Technology, Sivakasi
Description: AAA College of Engineering and Technology, Sivakasi, established in 2013, is a recognised affiliated college situated in Virudhunagar, Tamil Nadu. Located in a vast area of 43.87 acres, the institute comprises numerous Engineering courses. AAA College of Engineering and Technology is one of the reputed technical colleges that is NAAC accredited and AICTE approved. The college has a total student enrolment of 624 and a faculty strength of 95 thereby creating a good academic ambience. The institute delivers 12 courses over two programmes concentrated in numerous Engineering fields including Computer Science, Mechanical, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering. AAA College of Engineering and Technology has many amenities and equipment that aim to improve the delivery of education in the college. The campus facilities include separate hostels for boys and girls, with large rooms for studies and recreation. A technical library with over 50, 000 technical documents consisting of textbooks, technical references, and electronic resources. The college caters to students’ health needs by having a first aid health facility, a round-the-clock ambulance service, and a modern well-equipped gym. In the academic sector, modern laboratory facilities meet the needs of different Engineering specialisations along with strong computer system support. There is also a well-equipped and healthy canteen, air-conditioned auditorium, and seminar halls for games and other activities of campus and other programmes. AAA College of Engineering and Technology is an institution that provides a wide variety of engineering courses. The institute offers 12 courses which consist of undergraduate and doctoral programmes. Undergraduate programmes include BE and B.Tech with specialisations in Computer Science and Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Civil Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence and Data Science. In addition, the college has Ph.D. courses in Computer Science and Engineering and Mechanical Engineering. All undergraduate programmes are full-time courses that take four years to complete. In undergraduate courses, a total of 624 students have been approved for intake across the different disciplines offered. AAA College of Engineering and Technology admits the majority of its students via the TNEA procedure. TNEA is a counselling process for admission for first-year undergraduate BE and BTech courses in institutions affiliated with Tamil Nadu. The counselling forms are filled by students who pass their higher secondary examination every academic year. The experience guarantees equal opportunities for all qualifying candidates and conformity to the set engineering criteria. The college follows TNEA rankings for admitting students into different specialisations in Engineering fields. The competency and efficiency of the institute concerning quality education and industry-oriented training have played a significant role in establishing AAA College of Engineering and Technology as one of the premier institutes of engineering education.

Description: Abdul Aziz Ansari Degree College was founded in 1996, the affiliated college is situated in Majdeeha, Shahganj, Jaunpur, Uttar Pradesh. This institution recognised by National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE), has many programmes to support educational needs. The college is endowed with a total student population of 566 and a faculty and staff of 22 members to ensure a proper learning environment. The institution teaches 2 courses in 2 programmes with an emphasis on education to signify polymathic academic endeavours. Abdul Aziz Ansari Degree College is affiliated with VBSPU Jaunpur. Abdul Aziz Ansari Degree College offers many amenities intended to improve the experience of the students within the institution. Sports lovers can henceforth make use of the college’s sports amenities, thus achieving the twin objective of having the body and the brain fashioned. Cultural and academic activities, the college has an auditorium to conduct the students’ activities and seminars. The library is a centre of learning and research and provides reference to the academic activities of students. Departmental laboratories are provided to meet all practical learning requirements and a health centre with adequate first aid amenities would be part of the amenities for students. Moreover, for the principle and development of the college, there are guest houses and waiting rooms for the visiting faculty and students of the college with kindness. Abdul Aziz Ansari Degree College has 2 full-time courses, which include undergraduate and diploma courses. The subject areas that the college offers comprise a Bachelor of Education and a Diploma in Elementary Education. The admission process at Abdul Aziz Ansari Degree College differs from one programme to another. The admission procedure for B.Ed and D.El.Ed programmes are fully merit-based depending on the marks scored in the qualifying examination and/ or the entrance test. The college also goes by any other method of selection as may be stipulated by the policy of the state government, U.T. Administration and the university.
